data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 晨光初醒的无防备凝望
data.description: 清晨纯白的薄纱窗帘透进清澈明亮的晨曦。诺亚在凌乱而舒适的大床上半撑起身子，丝绸睡裙肩带微微滑落，瀑布般的银白长发铺散在枕头间。她半眯着清透的紫眸，嘴角噙着一抹安心至极的清纯微笑，静静凝望着身侧刚刚苏醒的老师。
data.action: waking up, propping up on elbow, messy hair on pillows, peaceful tender smile
data.lighting: bright ethereal morning sunshine diffusing through white sheer curtains
data.mood: pure peaceful bliss and morning warmth
data.promptProse: Awakening in a bright sunlit bed with rumpled white sheets, Ushio Noa props herself up on one elbow in her silk nightgown, her silver locks pooling on pillows as she smiles tenderly.
data.animaCaption: Noa waking up gently in the bright morning sunlight.
